pageDescription: MLI works with U.S. Support Services Inc. to provide housing for MLI students.
title: Accommodations
subtitle:
MLI works with U.S. Support Services Inc. to provide housing for MLI students.
For more details, please visit www.usssinc.net
note: Students can choose either homestay or dormitory accommodations.

types.title: Dormitory
description: We provide 40 rooms at our dormitories. There will be a lot of opportunities to communicate with other international students. We recommend you stay in a dormitory if you are on a budget.
lists: Room : Private (Individual), Shared (2 people) and Quad (4 people)
Meal : No meals (a fully furnished kitchen is available)
Privacy : There is more privacy than homestay. There are some dormitory rules.
Commute : about 20 minutes by foot or bus.

prices.title: Dormitory Prices

table.title:
Placement Fee* : $200
If younger than 18 years old, the rent will be approximately 10% higher than the price for a person older than 18 years old.

notes:
*Placement fee is a one time payment. It's not refundable.
**Security deposit will be refunded after students have moved out.

types.title: Homestay
description: Students who choose to live with a homestay family are looking for a safe, welcoming, and comfortable atmosphere in which they can practice their English skills. It's also an opportunity to learn about American customs, traditions, and family values.
lists: Privacy : There are some house rules depending on the host family.

prices.title: Homestay Prices

table.title:
Placement Fee* : $300
If younger than 18 years old, the rent will be approximately 10% higher than the price for a person older than 18 years old.

notes:
*Placement fee is a one time payment. It's not refundable.
**Security deposit will be refunded after students have moved out.
***If you request a homestay shared room, you must apply with another person.

comments.title: Comments from our staff
description: It is not easy to find a place to stay when you first arrive in the U.S., especially for international students who do not have a Social Security Number (SSN) and credit history.

Most places require both a SSN and credit history to rent a place.
Therefore, we reccommend you stay at our accommodations for at least the first couple of months.
※Your accommodation will be provided by U.S. Support Service Inc. or other agents.
